entities.title: Games
entities.summary: The games, one folder each, sharing no code at build time.
entities.purpose: Groups the games: Rally (rally/), Shatterbelt (shatterbelt/), Hivestorm (hivestorm/), Samosa (dictator/) and Gambit (chess/), each an npm project and a Cloudflare Worker, and LodeStar (lodestar/), a Rust and Godot desktop game, MEG (meg/), an npm project and a Cloudflare Worker whose high-score table is a Durable Object, Hedgerow (hedgerow/), a Godot client served by a Cloudflare Worker with no database, Neon Snake (snake/) and Swarmhold (swarmhold/), likewise Godot clients each served by a Cloudflare Worker with no database. Each game's folder is worked in on its own, with its own install and tests. Double Cross (double-cross/) is a Godot game whose online matches go through the games hub's relay.
boundaries: A game with a package.json is tested on every pull request that changes it (.github/scripts/changed-games.sh); a change to its .dev folders alone is not. Nothing deploys on a merge: each game is deployed by hand with npm run deploy in its folder. LodeStar has none, so the workflows leave it out.
Rally, Shatterbelt and Hivestorm carry identical copies of src/online.ts, and Rally copies Samosa's name rules; the copies are tracked as debt in games/rally/src/.dev/backlog.json.
